text: 71 Abhi was a well-mannered boy. He was liked by all. His parents taught him good habits. They wanted him to be a good person. Moral : Honesty is the best policy. One day, Abhi went to his friend’s house. His friend was not at home. Abhi saw a pencil box lying on the table. It was a beautiful box. Abhi liked it very much. Abhi wanted to take the pencil box home. But suddenly, he remembered his mother’s words. She always told him to be honest. She had told him not to take anything that did not belong to him. So, without touching the pencil box, he came back home. Abhi felt happy that he had done the right thing. 1. Listen and read aloud. Honest Abhi 4.7
